_comment: Copy this file to harness/seats.json (gitignored) and fill it in. One entry per LLM seat in a shared LAN game: each gets its own Civ5 instance and profile (scripts/launch_seat.sh <name>) on its own tuner port (unique, not 4318, which the primary/human instance keeps), its own tunerd on that port, and its own MCP server pointed at that tunerd's socket (CIV5_TUNERD_SOCK). Nothing here is a secret any more: the HTTP server that took per-seat API keys was removed on 2026-09-27.
